cards.ex: They kept me completely in the dark about the project's problems.
cards.exUz: Ular meni loyihaning muammolari haqida butunlay bexabar qoldirishdi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida hech narsa bilmaslik, ma'lumotsiz bo'lish.

cards.ex: I think I'm starting to get the picture of what happened.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, nima bo'lganini tushunishni boshlayapman.
cards.uzDef: Vaziyatni yoki nimanidir tushunish, anglab yetish.

cards.ex: It's common knowledge that smoking is bad for your health.
cards.exUz: Chekish sog'liq uchun zararli ekanligi hammaga ma'lum.
cards.uzDef: Hamma biladigan, hammaga ma'lum bo'lgan fakt yoki ma'lumot.

cards.ex: It takes a while to learn the ropes when you start a new job.
cards.exUz: Yangi ish boshlaganda, ishni o'rganish uchun biroz vaqt kerak bo'ladi.
cards.uzDef: Yangi ishni yoki faoliyatni qanday bajarishni o'rganish.

cards.ex: She's a quick study and picked up the language in no time.
cards.exUz: U tez o'rganuvchi va tilni juda tez o'rgandi.
cards.uzDef: Nimani tezda o'rganadigan odam.

cards.ex: I lost track of the conversation when they started talking about politics.
cards.exUz: Ular siyosat haqida gapira boshlaganlarida, men suhbatni yo'qotib qo'ydim.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida ma'lumotni yoki esda saqlashni to'xtatish.

cards.ex: I need to brush up on my French before my trip to Paris.
cards.exUz: Parijga sayohatimdan oldin fransuz tilimni takrorlashim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bilimlaringizni yaxshilash yoki eslatib olish uchun o'rganish.

cards.ex: I have a gut feeling that something's not right.
cards.exUz: Nimadir noto'g'ri ekanligi haqida ichki tuyg'uga egaman.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday faktga asoslanmagan, ammo kuchli his qilingan tuyg'u.

cards.ex: The exam was a piece of cake.
cards.exUz: Imtihon juda oson edi.
cards.uzDef: Juda oson bo'lgan narsa.

cards.ex: You have to read between the lines to understand what she really meant.
cards.exUz: Uning aslida nimani nazarda tutganini tushunish uchun satrlar orasidan o'qishingiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Aytilgan narsalardan tashqari yashirin ma'noni tushunish.

cards.ex: We need to make sure everyone is on the same page before we start.
cards.exUz: Ishni boshlashdan oldin hamma bir xil fikrda ekanligiga ishonch hosil qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Bitta mavzu bo'yicha bir xil fikrda bo'lish.

cards.ex: That movie gave me a lot of food for thought.
cards.exUz: Bu film menga ko'p o'ylashga ozuqa berdi.
cards.uzDef: O'ylashga turtki bo'ladigan narsa.

cards.ex: That name doesn't ring a bell.
cards.exUz: Bu ism menga hech narsani eslatmayapti.
cards.uzDef: Eslab qolishga yordam beradigan narsa, tanishdek tuyulish.

cards.ex: I need to hit the books tonight, I have a test tomorrow.
cards.exUz: Bugun kechqurun dars qilishim kerak, ertaga testim bor.
cards.uzDef: O'qish uchun vaqt ajratish, dars qilish.

cards.ex: I'm drawing a blank; I can't remember his name.
cards.exUz: Hech narsani eslay olmayapman; uning ismini eslay olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Hech narsani eslay olmaslik, xotira o'chganidek bo'lish.

cards.ex: We need to grasp the nettle and deal with the problem immediately.
cards.exUz: Biz qiyinchilikka kirishib, muammoni darhol hal qilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Qiyin vazifani hal qilishga jur'at etish.

cards.ex: I can't make sense of these instructions.
cards.exUz: Men bu ko'rsatmalarning ma'nosini tushuna olmayapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimanidir tushunish, ma'nosini anglash.

cards.ex: I'm trying to get my head around this new software.
cards.exUz: Men ushbu yangi dasturni tushunishga harakat qilyapman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir murakkab narsani tushunishga harakat qilish.

cards.ex: His lack of knowledge about the subject was obvious.
cards.exUz: Uning bu mavzu haqidagi bilimsizligi yaqqol ko'rinib turardi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida yetarli bilimga ega emaslik.

cards.ex: My grandfather was a wise man, always giving good advice.
cards.exUz: Mening bobom dono odam edi, har doim yaxshi maslahatlar berardi.
cards.uzDef: Katta bilim va tajribaga ega bo'lgan odam.

cards.ex: She has the know-how to fix any computer problem.
cards.exUz: U har qanday kompyuter muammosini hal qilish uchun bilimga ega.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni qanday qilish haqida amaliy bilim va ko'nikma.

cards.ex: I don't have a clue what you're talking about.
cards.exUz: Siz nima haqida gapirayotganingizni tasavvur ham qilmayman.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida ozgina bo'lsa ham tasavvurga ega bo'lish.

cards.ex: I need some time to figure out how to do this.
cards.exUz: Buni qanday qilishni aniqlash uchun biroz vaqt kerak.
cards.uzDef: Muammoni yechish yoki nimadirni tushunish.

cards.ex: It's hard to keep up with all the new technology.
cards.exUz: Barcha yangi texnologiyalardan xabardor bo'lish qiyin.
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi yangiliklardan xabardor bo'lish.

cards.ex: We had to learn the poem by heart for class.
cards.exUz: Biz dars uchun she'rni yod olishimiz kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Nimadirni to'liq yod olmoq.

cards.ex: Sometimes, ignorance is bliss; I don't want to know all the details.
cards.exUz: Ba'zan, bilmaslik baxt; men barcha tafsilotlarni bilishni xohlamayman.
cards.uzDef: Yomon narsalar haqida bilmaslik yaxshiroq degan ma'noda.

cards.ex: I need to get you up to speed on the project.
cards.exUz: Sizni loyiha haqida xabardor qilishim kerak.
cards.uzDef: Oxirgi ma'lumotlarga ega bo'lish, xabardor bo'lish.

cards.ex: Don't jump to conclusions; wait until you have all the facts.
cards.exUz: Xulosa chiqarishga shoshilmang; barcha faktlarga ega bo'lguningizcha kuting.
cards.uzDef: Dalillarni to'liq ko'rib chiqmasdan xulosa chiqarish.

cards.ex: You hit the nail on the head when you said it was a communication problem.
cards.exUz: Aloqa muammosi ekanligini aytganingizda to'g'ri aytdingiz.
cards.uzDef: To'g'ri gapni aytmoq, muammoni to'g'ri hal qilmoq.

cards.ex: I have a hunch that he's not telling the truth.
cards.exUz: U haqiqatni aytmayotganligi haqida sezgim bor.
cards.uzDef: Nimadir haqida aniq dalil bo'lmagan sezgi yoki taxmin.
